case: CASE-001 cn-hk dividend (Shenzhen Chenguang -> Brightpeak Holdings (HK))
note: Ground truth for the extraction stage. Variable names follow rule/variable.csv; every value names the document and the passage it comes from. Fictitious data except the documents under documents/real/.
transaction_status: planned: the dividend was resolved on 2026-03-20 and is payable by 2026-04-30; not yet paid when the background was entered

amount.quote: 晨峰控股（香港）有限公司：人民币 14,000,000.00 元（70%）

holding_months.derivation: 2019-06-30 to the payment date 2026-04-30 = 82 months of continuous holding; S10 note 8 confirms the acquisition date

payee_listed_in_partner.basis: a private company with a single corporate member

parent_treaty_not_worse.derivation: cn-sg.outbound_wht.dividend_rate_reduced = 5 with holding_pct_min 25 equals cn-hk.outbound_wht.dividend_rate_reduced = 5 with 25; the parent would receive the same benefit (STA 2018 No. 9 item 3, 'qualifying person')

passes_on_within_12m.quote: No resolution was passed; the matter was deferred pending tax advice
passes_on_within_12m.caveat: the parent has asked for onward distribution (S09 item 4); an obligation by contract or established practice would turn this factor against beneficial ownership (STA 2018 No. 9 item 2(1)); the 2024 dividend was retained (S10, S12)

substantive_business.quote: The principal activity of the Company is investment holding ... The Company had no employees during the year

employees_in_jurisdiction.quote: The Company had no employees during the year (2024: none)

premises_in_jurisdiction.quote: address of the company secretary, Harbourline Corporate Services Limited

bo.basis: pure holding company, no employees (S10 note 6), registered office and administration provided by the secretary (S08, S15), sole shareholder has asked for onward distribution (S09 item 4); the item-4 safe harbours do not apply (private company owned by a Singapore company)

parent_bo.basis: Brightpeak Asia Pte. Ltd. has three employees and regional holding activities (S14) and would be a 'qualifying person' under item 3 (same 5% benefit under the China-Singapore treaty); whether it itself is beneficial owner under the item-2 factors has not been examined

ppt.basis: the Hong Kong company was interposed in 2019 by acquisition from another Hong Kong company (S02 change record); purpose not documented

gaar.basis: no artificial step beyond the holding structure itself; the same question is covered by bo and ppt

substance.basis: s15K(2)(a): a pure equity-holding entity needs adequate human resources and premises in Hong Kong; the company has none (S10 note 6, S15)

fsie_mpr.basis: the holding predates the FSIE regime (acquired 2019, regime from 2023); no arrangement entered into in respect of the dividend

dividend_2024.refund_note: under STA 2019 No. 35 art. 10 only the excess over the treaty rate is refundable: 5,880,000 x (10% - 5%) = 294,000 if the 2024 payment qualified for 5%; the 840,000 figure in S06 is the whole tax withheld on RMB 8,400,000, of which the Hong Kong shareholder's part was RMB 5,880,000 (70%)

expected_questions: bo or parent_bo (DISCRETION; either route establishes beneficial ownership)
